result.instructions: Tools for TimeCamp, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my tracked time for last week, grouped by task."; "Create a 45-minute time entry for the Website project today, with the note 'client call'."; "Is a timer running for me right now, and on which task?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TimeCamp data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timecamp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timecamp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timecamp_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timecamp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timecamp_get_user
tools.title: Get my user
tools.description: Get the TimeCamp user behind the API token: user_id, email, display name, root group and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. TimeCamp API: GET /me.

tools.name: timecamp_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (projects and tasks you can track time on), as an object keyed by task id, with parent ids, names and archive state. Filter by task id, external id or status. TimeCamp API: GET /tasks.

task_ids.description: Comma-separated task ids to return, e.g. "123,456".

external_task_id.description: Return the task with this external id (from another system).

status.description: Filter tasks by status, as the API defines it.

tools.name: timecamp_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries between two dates (inclusive), optionally for given users, tasks or tags. Returns the entries the token may see. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/time-entries/list.

user_ids.description: Only entries of these user ids.

task_ids.description: Only entries on these task ids.

tag_ids.description: Only entries with these tag ids.

tools.name: timecamp_get_timer_status
tools.title: Get timer status
tools.description: Get the timer of the token's user: whether a timer runs, on which task, and since when. TimeCamp API: GET /v3/timer/status.

tools.name: timecamp_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create time entry
tools.description: Create a time entry for the token's user on one day. Give start and end time, or a duration in seconds. Adds a new entry on every call. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/time-entries/create.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds. Omit to compute it from start and end time.

task_id.description: Task to track the time on (from timecamp_list_tasks).

tools.name: timecamp_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update time entry
tools.description: Change one time entry by id: date, start and end time, duration, task, note or billable flag. Only the fields you pass change. With increase=true, the duration adds to the current one. TimeCamp API: PUT /v3/time-entries/{id}.

start_time.description: New start time, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

end_time.description: New end time, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

increase.description: When true, add duration_seconds to the current duration instead of replacing it.

tools.name: timecamp_delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete time entry
tools.description: Delete one time entry by id. The entry is removed from TimeCamp; this cannot be undone through this tool. TimeCamp API: DELETE /v3/time-entries/{id}.

entry_id.description: The time entry id to delete (from timecamp_list_time_entries).

tools.name: timecamp_start_timer
tools.title: Start timer
tools.description: Start a timer for the token's user on a task. The timer records time until it is stopped. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/timer/start.

tools.name: timecamp_stop_timer
tools.title: Stop timer
tools.description: Stop a running timer and save its time as an entry. Omit timer_id to stop the token user's current timer. TimeCamp API: POST /v3/timer/stop.

timer_id.description: Running timer id. Omit to stop the current timer of the token's user.

prompts.title: Get started with TimeCamp
